generatedDescription: Svirfneblin Magic is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes.

name: Tandem Tactician
effectSummary: Use Help as a bonus action. When using Help to aid an ally's attack, increase its range by 10 feet and you may help two allies targeting the same creature within range.
generatedDescription: Tandem Tactician is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 73 - Feats.

name: Tavern Brawler
effectSummary: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, maximum 20. Gain proficiency with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 damage die. After hitting a creature on your turn with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon, use a bonus action to attempt to grapple it.
generatedDescription: Tavern Brawler is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Telekinetic
effectSummary: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, maximum 20. Learn mage hand using the increased ability; cast it without verbal or somatic components and make the hand invisible. If you already know it, its range increases by 30 feet. As a bonus action, choose a visible creature within 30 feet; it makes or willingly fails a Strength save against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the increased ability, and on failure moves 5 feet toward or away from you.
generatedDescription: Telekinetic is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

name: Telepathic
effectSummary: Increase Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, maximum 20. Telepathically speak to a visible creature within 60 feet in a language you know; it understands only if it knows that language and cannot reply telepathically through this feature. Cast detect thoughts once without a spell slot or components per long rest and also with 2nd-level-or-higher slots; its spellcasting ability is the one increased by this feat.
generatedDescription: Telepathic is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

name: Theologian
effectSummary: Increase Intelligence by 1, maximum 20. Gain Religion proficiency, or expertise if already proficient. Learn thaumaturgy and detect evil and good; cast detect evil and good once without a slot per long rest.
generatedDescription: Theologian is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 38 - Feats for Skills.

name: Thrown Arms Master
effectSummary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, maximum 20. Simple and martial melee weapons without thrown gain thrown for you: one-handed range 20/60, two-handed 15/30. Weapons already thrown increase normal range by 20 feet and long range by 40 feet. When you miss with a thrown light weapon, it returns to your grasp at the end of your turn unless prevented; you can catch and stow all such returning weapons.
generatedDescription: Thrown Arms Master is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn.

name: Tough
effect: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.
generatedDescription: Tough is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Tower of Iron Will

prerequisites.text: Psionic Talent feature or Wild Talent feat

effect: Your mind’s defenses are formidable. After you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll your Psionic Talent die and add the number rolled to the saving throw, potentially causing it to succeed.
generatedDescription: Tower of Iron Will is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 71 - Psionic Options Revisited.

name: Tracker
effectSummary: Increase Wisdom by 1, maximum 20. Learn hunter's mark, using Wisdom as spellcasting ability; cast it once without a slot per long rest and also with appropriate spell slots. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures.
generatedDescription: Tracker is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 73 - Feats.

name: Vampiric Exultation

During a short rest, whenever you eat food and spend one or more Hit Dice to regain HP, regain additional HP equal to Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus.
generatedDescription: Vigor of the Hill Giant is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Bigby Presents - Glory of the Giants.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
effectSummary: When an effect would move you at least 5 feet or knock you prone, use your reaction to prevent both. When a spell restores your HP, you may regain additional HP equal to your Constitution modifier; uses equal proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Vital Sacrifice
effectSummary: As a bonus action, take 1d6 necrotic damage that cannot be reduced to gain a blood boon lasting 1 hour or until spent. Spend it to add 1d6 to one attack roll; add 2d6 necrotic damage when you hit with an attack or spell; or, when you cause a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution save, roll 1d4 and subtract it from that save.
generatedDescription: Vital Sacrifice is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn.

name: War Caster

prerequisites.label: Prerequisite
prerequisites.text: The ability to cast at least one spell

effectSummary: Gain advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration when you take damage. You can perform somatic spell components even with weapons or a shield in one or both hands. When hostile movement would provoke an opportunity attack, use your reaction to cast a spell instead; it must have a casting time of 1 action and target only that creature.
generatedDescription: War Caster is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Weapon Master
effectSummary: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, maximum 20. Gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.
generatedDescription: Weapon Master is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Wild Talent
effectSummary: Increase one ability score by 1, maximum 20, and gain a Psionic Talent die starting at d6. When making an ability check with the increased ability, roll the Psionic Talent die and add it before knowing success or failure. Once per turn when an attack using that ability hits, after rolling damage you may roll the Psionic Talent die and replace one attack damage die with that result. Rolling the die's maximum lowers it one die size after the roll; rolling 1 raises it one size up to its starting size. If reduced below d4 it becomes unusable until a long rest. Its starting size becomes d8 at level 5, d10 at 11, and d12 at 17; if another source grants a Psionic Talent die, use only the one with the largest starting size. Once per long rest as a bonus action, restore the die to its starting size.
generatedDescription: Wild Talent is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 71 - Psionic Options Revisited.

name: Wonder Maker
effectSummary: Increase Dexterity or Intelligence by 1, maximum 20. Double your proficiency bonus on checks using tinker’s tools. Your Tinker trait gains additional device options: Alarm detects a creature entering within 15 feet without the password and rings 1 round later for 1 minute, audible 300 feet; Calculator assists with arithmetic; Lifter acts as block and tackle allowing five times normal lift; Timekeeper keeps accurate time; Weather Sensor, used as an action, predicts each hour of weather in a 1-mile radius for the next 4 hours with simple symbols.
generatedDescription: Wonder Maker is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Unearthed Arcana 39 - Feats for Races.

name: Wood Elf Magic
effectSummary: Learn one druid cantrip plus longstrider and pass without trace. Cast longstrider and pass without trace once each without a slot per long rest. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability for all three spells.
generatedDescription: Wood Elf Magic is a D&D 5e feat. Source: Xanathar's Guide to Everything.
